page.layout: One block of text in the right half of the page, with a spaced-capitals line at the top; the left half is blank. The lower right has a further faint block of lines. No notes in the margins, no page number, no catchword.
page.notes: The scan is very faint and low in contrast. The text at the top right and the block of lines below it are visible as printed lines, but at this resolution I cannot read individual letters, so every line is marked illegible rather than guessed. The spaced-capitals line at the top may be a running head or a heading; I could not tell which, so I have given it as the running head. The paragraph breaks are also uncertain. The lower right block appears to continue with more lines, which are not transcribed. The rest of the page is blank paper, and the page edges and show-through have been left out. Rescanning at higher contrast or a larger size would allow a proper transcription.
